results.title: Adaptive Control of Robot Manipulators With Uncertain Kinematics and Dynamics
results.snippet: In this paper, we investigate the adaptive control problem for robot manipulators with both the uncertain kinematics and dynamics. We propose two adaptive control schemes to realize the objective of task-space trajectory tracking irrespective of the uncertain kinematics and dynamics. The proposed controllers have the desirable separation property, and we also show that the first adaptive controller with appropriate modifications can yield improved performance, without the expense of conservative gain choice. The performance of the proposed controllers is shown by numerical simulations.

results.title: Safe Control Synthesis via Input Constrained Control Barrier Functions
results.snippet: This paper introduces the notion of an Input Constrained Control Barrier Function (ICCBF), as a method to synthesize safety-critical controllers for non-linear control affine systems with input constraints. The method identifies a subset of the safe set of states, and constructs a controller to render the subset forward invariant. The feedback controller is represented as the solution to a quadratic program, which can be solved efficiently for real-time implementation. results.title: A Real-Time Model-Based Reinforcement Learning Architecture for Robot Control
results.snippet: Reinforcement Learning (RL) is a method for learning decision-making tasks that could enable robots to learn and adapt to their situation on-line. For an RL algorithm to be practical for robotic control tasks, it must learn in very few actions, while continually taking those actions in real-time. Existing model-based RL methods learn in relatively few actions, but typically take too much time between each action for practical on-line learning. results.title: One-Shot Reinforcement Learning for Robot Navigation with Interactive Replay
results.snippet: Recently, model-free reinforcement learning algorithms have been shown to solve challenging problems by learning from extensive interaction with the environment. A significant issue with transferring this success to the robotics domain is that interaction with the real world is costly, but training on limited experience is prone to overfitting. We present a method for learning to navigate, to a fixed goal and in a known environment, on a mobile robot. results.title: Grasp and Motion Planning for Dexterous Manipulation for the Real Robot Challenge
results.snippet: This report describes our winning submission to the Real Robot Challenge (https://real-robot-challenge.com/). The Real Robot Challenge is a three-phase dexterous manipulation competition that involves manipulating various rectangular objects with the TriFinger Platform. Our approach combines motion planning with several motion primitives to manipulate the object. For Phases 1 and 2, we additionally learn a residual policy in simulation that applies corrective actions on top of our controller. findings.point: 当前视觉基础机器人仿真基准已显著推动操作研究，但面向真实世界通用策略的评测体系滞后，缺乏系统性的 sim-to-real 迁移基准设计原则

## 4. 瓶颈与拐点

|------|----------|----------|----------|------|
| **实时性与确定性**：ROS 2 在非实时内核上难以满足高频控制（>1kHz）确定性延迟需求 | [4], [3] | 工程/系统级 | PREEMPT_RT 内核主线化、ROS 2 Real-Time Working Group 成果落地 [3] | 环形缓冲区执行器 [3]、分布式实时架构 [4] 显示社区正攻克该瓶颈 |
| **Sim-to-Real Gap 量化缺失**：缺乏标准化协议预测仿真性能向真实性能的迁移 | [2] | 方法论/基础设施 | RSS 2025 提出三大设计原则 [2]、Isaac Sim / MuJoCo / Genesis 视觉保真度提升 | 高视觉保真仿真 + 系统性扰动评估 + 对齐度量三原则若落地将形成拐点 |
| **安全关键控制标准化**：CBF/ICBF 理论成熟但工程集成碎片化 | [6], [14] | 理论-工程鸿沟 | 双凸优化 CBF 实时避障 [14]、ICCBF QP 形式 [6] 为标准化提供数学基础 | ros2_control 安全层插件标准化若达成共识将加速落地 |
| **多模态感知融合与控制协同延迟**：VLA 大模型推理延迟（~100-500ms）与控制回路（1-10ms）时尺度错配 | [2], [5] | 架构/算力 | ROS-Causal 因果框架 [5]、行为树/运动基元分层控制 | 分层架构（高层 VLA 规划 + 低层实时控制器）为主流缓解方向 |
| **运动学标定与动力学辨识自动化**：真机部署仍依赖人工标定，缺乏在线自适应标定通用框架 | [7], [11] | 工程/运维 | 2014 自适应控制理论 [7]、2024 连续体机器人实验验证 [11] | 在线参数估计与自适应控制融合为潜在拐点方向 |
